_comment: Posts renamed to the title a committed official document prints, so the pay routes that join by
name can reach them. scripts/rename_posts_to_printed_titles.py is the only writer of these renames;
the curated file is never hand-edited. Every row is re-checked against its committed fixture on every
run (digest recomputed from the bytes): the table proposes, the document decides. 'from' is the name
the row was written against; a node that no longer carries it is left alone. 'parentId' is the parent
the row was written against; a node moved elsewhere is left alone.
Licences: 'schedule_8_footnote_title' -- 'printed' must be one printed item of the enlisted footnote to
Schedule 8 in the note to 5 U.S.C. 5332, read exactly as military_pay.py reads it, and 'to' must be that
item. 'us_code_counted_class_title' -- 'printed' must be a counted class title ('... (N)') in the
section's OPERATIVE text, 'singular' must be that title's plural noun phrase with its trailing 's'
removed, 'to' must be the singular, a separator from statutory_schedule.COUNTED_CLASS_SEPARATORS and the
qualifier the node already carries after the same separator, and 'composedBy' (a second section) must
print its quote in its operative text. No more rows may cite one class than the class title counts.

'opm_current_plum_export_title' (since 2026-10-08) -- 'printed' must be a title OPM's committed current PLUM export prints verbatim on exactly one live (Filled or Vacant) listing filed under the row's 'agency' and 'organization', read through plum_current.load_plum_export (READ_COLUMNS only, digest recomputed), and 'to' must reduce to it under canonical_name_key.

renames.to: Chief Master Sergeant of the Space Force
renames.printed: Chief Master Sergeant of the Space Force
renames.basis: The owner's decision (2026-10-07): the U.S. Space Force's senior enlisted advisor is the office Schedule 8 of the pay-adjustment order (reproduced in the note to 5 U.S.C. 5332) names in its enlisted footnote as 'Chief Master Sergeant of the Space Force', beside the Sergeant Major of the Army, the Chief Master Sergeant of the Air Force and the others this graph already names that way. The footnote prints the title; which office the graph's generic 'Senior Enlisted Advisor' stood for is the owner's identification and no document here states it. 10 U.S.C. 9083 (committed as sf_10_usc_9083_govinfo2024.html) was read and names only the Vice Chief of Space Operations, so it is not cited.

renames.from: Associate Director — Advanced Scientific Computing Research
renames.to: Associate Director, Office of Advanced Scientific Computing Research
renames.printed: ASSOCIATE DIRECTOR, OFFICE OF ADVANCED SCIENTIFIC COMPUTING RESEARCH
renames.basis: The owner's decision (2026-10-08, CURATION.md §19.25): OPM's current Plum Book export lists this post under the Department of Energy's Office of Science as 'ASSOCIATE DIRECTOR, OFFICE OF ADVANCED SCIENTIFIC COMPUTING RESEARCH'; the graph's 'Associate Director — Advanced Scientific Computing Research' is the same office with 'Office of' and the comma dropped. The export prints the title; the casing is the reviewer's. The operative text of 5 U.S.C. 5312-5316 prints the Office's Director (5315) and no Associate Director of it.

renames.to: Executive Assistant Director for Emergency Communications
renames.printed: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT DIRECTOR FOR EMERGENCY COMMUNICATIONS
renames.basis: The owner's decision (2026-10-08, CURATION.md §19.25): the export lists the post under CISA as 'EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT DIRECTOR FOR EMERGENCY COMMUNICATIONS', the title 6 U.S.C. 571(b) gives the head of the Emergency Communications Division (committed as cisa_6_usc_571_govinfo2024.html). Checked before the row was written: unlike 6 U.S.C. 653 and 654 for CISA's other two Executive Assistant Directors, section 571 states no level, and the operative text of 5 U.S.C. 5312-5316 prints no 'Assistant Director for Emergency Communications' item for 571(g)'s deeming rule to reach, so the export's ES listing contradicts no Code provision.
